description: Read your saved jobs and application tracker with a status filter. Use ready_to_send for approvals, needs_answer for outstanding questions, not_sent for applications that were tried but never reached the employer (with the reason and whether you can retry), or stale to review inactive applied rows. Returns up to 20 rows per page; while next_cursor is not null, call again with cursor set to it for the next page. Also returns full per-stage totals and the record: how many applications were sent, wait for your answers or were not sent and why, and the employer replies in your inbox. Never sends, archives or changes stages.

cursor.description: The next_cursor from the previous list_applications result with the same status. Omit it for the first page.

stale_days.description: Inactivity window for the stale view; defaults to 14 days.

name: list_applications

counts.description: Total counts per stage across the user's full history, independent of any stage filter or limit.

holds.description: The runs of the ready_to_send, needs_answer and not_sent views, newest first, each with listing_id, listing_title and company_name; empty for the other views.

can_retry.description: Whether the review page can send this job again now: its questions have saved answers. Open review_url to retry it.

reason.description: Why this run was not sent, in the Applications page's words; null while it is live or once it was sent.

review_url.description: Hosted review for this run. Open this URL when next_action is open_review.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor, with the same status, to read the next page. Null on the last page.

record.description: The Applications page record, independent of any status filter or limit.

not_confirmed.description: Not sent attempts whose submit went out but the employer never confirmed receipt: they may have reached the employer. Included in not_sent.

not_sent.description: Attempts you started or called off that never reached the employer and wait on nothing, plus not_confirmed, the Not sent tab.

not_sent_reasons.description: The most common reasons, most attempts first.

reason.description: Why these attempts were not sent; null when no reason was recorded.

replies.description: Employer emails in your inbox by kind, whether or not they were tied to a tracked application.

sent.description: Applications that reached an employer, the Applications page Sent tab.

waiting.description: Jobs that wait on an answer from you, the Waiting tab.

waiting_questions.description: The questions most waiting jobs need answered, most jobs first.

application_id.description: Null for a saved listing with no job_applications row yet, and for a send that has no tracker card.

archived_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the user's own decision to retire this row from the tracker's active surfaces. Null when they never archived it.

dormant.description: Whether the tracker has stopped showing this row on its active surfaces: it was archived, or it is an applied row with no activity for 30 days. Dormant rows stay in the user's History and are restored in one click.

stale_total.description: All stale rows for the stale view, oldest first in rows; null for other views.

title: List your applications
